templates.title: Private-network Hosted Agent
templates.description: Demonstrates security and data-protection controls for a Hosted Agent solution, including VNet isolation, private endpoints, restricted egress, managed identity, and customer-managed keys.

templates.title: APIM-hosted Foundry Agent
templates.description: Demonstrates governed agent, model, and tool traffic through API Management.

templates.title: Enterprise Knowledge Agent
templates.description: Demonstrates grounding with custom data from Fabric, databases, org APIs, and Microsoft IQs, and shows a typical RAG setup with a hosted agent, including connection and authentication best practices.

templates.title: AG-UI Web Client for a Hosted Agent
templates.description: Demonstrates a browser chat client for a Hosted Agent over AG-UI with CopilotKit, including Microsoft Entra sign-in, per-user threads, and human approval of agent actions.
